title: Syrian Tagine with Rice
description: A traditional Syrian dish made with rice and a hearty tagine sauce. This flavorful recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the Syrian tagine and cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the rice to the saucepan and stir to combine with the tagine.
Add the water to the saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until the rice is tender.
Fluff the rice with a fork and serve.
